concerns.location: spec.md:FR-008 / SC-003 vs constitution.md Principle VII
concerns.text: FR-008 and SC-003 require metrics 'for each metabolite' only, while Constitution Principle VII mandates R²/RMSE/MAE 'reported separately for each stress category (drought, salinity, metal toxicity)' and forbids a single aggregate metric without demonstrated cross-stress consistency. The spec's evaluation requirements are internally incompatible with the ratified constitution; FR-008/SC-003 should be extended to per-stress-type reporting.

US-1 scenario 3 states 'all predictors are standardized (zero mean, unit variance)', but FR-005 only mandates kNN imputation and log-transformation of metabolites — predictor standardization appears in the story but in no functional requirement. Add it to FR-005 (or a new FR) so story and requirements agree.

Edge case 'Outliers beyond 3 standard deviations should be capped at the 1st/99th percentile' is specified behavior with no corresponding FR; the spec's edge-case section and FR list are inconsistent about whether capping is required. Either add an FR or mark the edge case as guidance.
